notes.title: Chapter 4: Beginning of the End (Preview Update)
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

It’s been some time since I gave any info on the fourth and final chapter of [b]My Beautiful Paper Smile[/b], so today I’ll be getting you all caught up.

On June 11th I did my first full playthrough test of the entire game, and luckily nothing blew up!  For the rest of that month, I did a bit more testing, fixed some bugs, and added the main text translations to the chapter.  The original plan was to release the game earlier in the summer, but due to some delays, we had to push the release date back a bit, so we apologize for the wait.  It’s certainly been longer than I hoped for, but hopefully, you all can hang in there a little longer.

At the time of writing this, I’m just waiting on some playtesting results, that way I can get as many bugs fixed as possible and eliminate any goofy mistakes I might have made during development.  Once I get these results all I need to do is make a few changes, fixes, and optimizations, and then it’ll be ready to launch.

In the meantime, I’ve been spending time researching some more of the interworking of the indie game industry, and have been experimenting with some different game ideas that I might develop fully after My Beautiful Paper Smile has been fully launched.  While MBPS has been in limbo for a few months, I’ve certainly been staying busy and I can’t wait to share more about my upcoming projects soon (follow [url=https://twitter.com/TwoStarGames]@TwoStarGames[/url] on Twitter for updates!).

Now that I’ve got all the status update stuff out of the way, here are some cool screenshots from chapter 4.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567924/1626783bd567bfe3d6ed57fdf4c46088d77b68a6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567924/39b5ab912930c1cbbc26a9310f129df2df31e9c4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567924/20d71d81f0306398eeec5d2f546b5297d7af32bc.jpg[/img]


Hope you all are excited to play the conclusion to this game because I can’t wait to get it out there for you.

Until next time!  Keep smiling :)

notes.title: Night in Riverager (Short Prequel Release)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today I get to announce a little project that I’m really excited to share with you all.  I introduce to you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1500380/Night_in_Riverager/]Night in Riverager[/url].

[previewyoutube=2kvv1oQYkD4;full]https://youtu.be/2kvv1oQYkD4 
[/previewyoutube]

Night in Riverager is a prequel and takes place in the same world and time as the events of [b]My Beautiful Paper Smile[/b].  It’s a short story that helps give more context to the MBPS world.  This is a story I wanted to be able to tell, but just couldn’t within the confines of the original storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567924/15eedd6d8603b4b9e3321b1c7cace40aabbdb5c6.png[/img]

The game follows the journey of a hunter named Lasciva, who lives with some of his family in Riverager, which is a remote corner of his country.  They live in hiding, hoping to evade the King and his Authorities, but on occasion, someone must leave the small precinct to gather supplies.  This is one of those nights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567924/e0f2e18067168b8d18b6933ce5b365a948b3968c.png[/img]

Night in Riverager is now available and free to play on Steam, itch.io, and Gamejolt, and I hope you’re all excited about it!

Additionally, Chapter IV is still underway and continues to be on schedule for its Summer release at this time. Currently in the writing phase of the Chapter and once moved into the visual phase you can expect to see more frequent visual updates at hand. 

Until next time!  Keep smiling :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1500380/Night_in_Riverager/

notes.title: Early Access Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

I wanted to share an exciting announcement in case you have not heard, [i]in less than a month[/i] from now, that chapter 1&2 of [b]My Beautiful Paper Smile [/b]will be releasing on Early Access  [b]June 19th![/b] with continued development to follow! Stay connected in our [url=https://discord.gg/MaAq8XJ]discord[/url] for continued support, questions, and progress. 

[previewyoutube=0n8HmN4XYAg;full][/previewyoutube]

That’s the main piece of info that you’ll need, but I want to talk briefly about the fine details and what you’ll be playing when it’s available.

My Beautiful Paper Smile has been in development for about two and a half years, and over that time it’s always been planned to be released chapter by chapter.  We’ve considered a few different ways to do this but decided that launching the first two chapters together for our June 19th early access launch would make the most sense.  Since the game is still being developed, we’ll be publishing the 3rd chapter later on as a major update, and the 4th chapter when we transition into a full launch.  This will allow you to get your hands on what we’ve created so far, and allow us to gain much better feedback so that the game can be as good as possible when it’s completed.

I hope you’re as excited as I am!

Until next time! Keep smiling :)
